source: Main manuscript Tables 1-4 and Supplementary Tables S4 and S6

libero.name: Held-out LIBERO
libero.protocol: 12 held-out tasks across four suites; 50 shared initial states per task; equal task weighting. Benchmark-specific adaptation uses the same held-out task boundaries.

simpler.name: SIMPLER-WidowX
simpler.protocol: 12 tasks: four standard, four extended, two dual-goal, and two sequential; 24 shared initial states per task. Overall weights all 12 tasks equally.

physical.name: Physical robot
physical.protocol: PiPER-X; four tasks, five human demonstrations and ten initial configurations per task, giving 50 trials per task and method. The same demonstration-configuration assignments are shared by video-conditioned methods.

ablations.protocol: Complete-task evaluation on the three held-out LIBERO-Long tasks; 50 rollouts per task and variant.

stages.protocol: Independent expert-initialized continuations. Each stage uses 50 matched starts per task across three held-out LIBERO-Long tasks (150 continuations per stage and method).

seen_tasks.protocol: 28 training-task identities under new initial conditions; 20 shared initial states per task.
